correctness.rationale: Fourier integration gives an exact 3x3 Gram matrix; explicit null polynomial supplies a uniform trial bound, analytic isolated-eigenvalue perturbation gives a matching fixed-separation asymptotic with C2 uniformity near the optimizer; the rational coefficient has one nondegenerate interior maximum. Global uniform trial bound rules out competing moving centers, local strict concavity proves uniqueness for all sufficiently small widths, and exact antipodal diagonalization fixes the ratio. The standalone exact/high-precision checker passed 1345 assertions; computation is not the proof.

value.rationale: The first primitive non-arithmetic three-frequency support provides a substantial and exact counterexample to extending known antipodal designs for consecutive triples to sparse bands. A unique non-antipodal optimal angle and a factor about 2.27281 in worst-case captured energy give a directly motivated sampling-stability fact rather than an arbitrary table entry; nonstandard null-polynomial optimization explains the phenomenon.
